docs.guides.outline.capabilities.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.guides.outline.capabilities.topic.c.message: Supported research activities, the local workspace model, and where to start for each input or goal.

docs.guides.outline.capabilities.topic.s.message: Accepted inputs, readable versus executable formats, and preparation before import.

docs.guides.outline.installation.scope.message: System requirements, desktop installation, source builds, update checks, and version selection.

docs.guides.outline.onboarding.scope.message: Environment checks, data location, agent runtime, model access, and Notebook setup in wizard order.

docs.guides.outline.first-project.scope.message: A small first task from project creation to a saved output and a clear success check.

docs.guides.outline.navigation.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.guides.outline.navigation.topic.nav.message: Home entries, workspace layout, sidebar panels, resizing, and returning to projects.

docs.guides.outline.navigation.topic.sea.message: Global search, result types, opening a result, and the difference from panel-level filters.

docs.guides.outline.projects.scope.message: Create and edit projects, project descriptions and Agent Context, folder selection, and access scope.

docs.guides.outline.sessions.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.guides.outline.sessions.topic.sessi.message: Start, switch, rename, and pin sessions; distinguish a project from its conversations.

docs.guides.outline.sessions.topic.revis.message: Edit a previous message, browse revisions, branch a conversation, and understand retained context.

docs.guides.outline.composer.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.guides.outline.composer.topic.compo.message: Compose a request, attach inputs, select Skills, and reference files or sessions before sending.

docs.guides.outline.composer.topic.follo.message: Queue, edit, reorder, send, and stop requests; explain what continues after interruption.

docs.guides.outline.files.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.guides.outline.files.topic.files.sc.message: Upload versus folder reference, file search and layouts, project copies, and download locations.

docs.guides.outline.files.topic.artifact.message: Distinguish uploads and generated artifacts; inspect saved revisions, edit supported managed files, compare supported text or Markdown changes, and export results.

docs.guides.outline.previews.scope.message: Split and full-screen previews, supported viewers, tabs, and format-specific controls.

docs.guides.outline.library.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.guides.outline.library.topic.librar.message: Add and import records, collections, project links, tags, duplicates, Trash, and restoration.

docs.guides.outline.library.topic.readin.message: PDF attachments, metadata and full-text retrieval, reading state, citation styles, copy and export.

docs.guides.outline.notebook.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.guides.outline.notebook.topic.noteb.message: Executed Python, R, and Bash units, outputs, variables, kernels, stopping, and notebook export.

docs.guides.outline.notebook.topic.prove.message: Inspect available links to source messages, code, notebook runs and review evidence for a version; explain missing evidence and format-dependent coverage.

docs.guides.outline.models.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.guides.outline.models.topic.models..message: Provider, model, agent framework, and Specialist distinctions; select an active model and effort.

docs.guides.outline.models.topic.scenari.message: Main, Subagent, Reviewer, Vision, and Session details policies, inheritance, and compatible choices.

docs.guides.outline.providers.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.guides.outline.providers.topic.prov.message: Provider presets, subscription sign-in or API access, custom endpoints, required fields, and connection tests.

docs.guides.outline.providers.topic.loca.message: Compatible local endpoints, model identifiers, capability limits, and connection verification.

docs.guides.outline.frameworks.scope.message: Framework installation, detection, authentication, activation, switching, repair, and removal.

docs.guides.outline.usage.scope.message: Reported token categories, time filters, charts, project/session counts, and missing telemetry.

docs.guides.outline.approval-modes.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.guides.outline.approval-modes.topic.message: Ask, auto-approve edits, and full access; inspect, allow, or deny a concrete request.
Session, project, and global scopes; inspect, revoke, and restore defaults without scope confusion.

docs.guides.outline.planning.scope.message: Plan-first entry, reviewing a proposed plan, feedback, approval, and continuing execution.

docs.guides.outline.delegation.scope.message: Inspect framework-supported delegation, subagent activity and Side Chat advice. Specialist creation, capability binding and Reviewer details belong to the Specialists section.

docs.guides.outline.memory.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.guides.outline.memory.topic.memory..message: Global and project notes, categories, auto-recall, manual editing, and retention when disabled.

docs.guides.outline.memory.topic.context.message: Inspect context use, understand retained history and compaction, and prepare a continuation or handoff.

docs.guides.outline.runtimes.scope.message: Managed and external interpreters, installation, enablement, package access, and rebuild impact.

docs.guides.outline.connectors.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.guides.outline.connectors.topic.con.message: Built-in and custom MCP setup, tool availability and policy, credential binding, and connection health.

docs.guides.outline.connectors.topic.cre.message: Device credentials, research contact details, API keys, tokens, OAuth, reuse, and removal.

docs.guides.outline.network.scope.message: Network checks, Notebook allowed domains, proxy modes, package mirrors, and certificate bundles.

docs.guides.outline.remote-compute.scope.message: Host authentication, direct versus scheduler mode, resource discovery, scratch paths, and concurrency.

docs.guides.outline.remote-access.scope.message: Remote.It prerequisites, access modes, pairing, trusted browsers, and revocation.

docs.guides.outline.appearance.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.guides.outline.appearance.topic.app.message: System/light/dark appearance, explicit interface language, and startup language behavior.

docs.guides.outline.appearance.topic.not.message: In-app messages, desktop task notifications, content visibility, delivery tests, and OS permissions.

docs.guides.outline.tags.scope.message: Create and edit tags, appearance, resource assignment, filtering, duplicate names, and deletion.

docs.guides.outline.storage.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.guides.outline.storage.topic.storag.message: Storage categories, refresh, directory boundaries, relocation, environment rebuilds, and recovery.

docs.guides.outline.storage.topic.archiv.message: Project/session archive and restore, permanent deletion, retained folders, and confirmation boundaries.

docs.guides.outline.shortcuts.scope.message: Navigation, search, composer, and preview shortcuts with platform differences.

docs.guides.outline.troubleshooting.scop.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.guides.outline.troubleshooting.topi.message: Symptom-based checks for startup, models, runtimes, files and network; collect useful diagnostics.
Clear answers about data ownership, account requirements, costs, offline use, and recovery; link to detailed guides.

docs.outline.workflows.scope.message: Research situations with a defined starting point and deliverable; interface operations belong inside each scenario.

docs.outline.workflows.cookbook.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.outline.workflows.cookbook.topic.co.message: Choose by research question, input type, expected output, and available resources.

docs.outline.workflows.cookbook.topic.fi.message: A small CSV example from import to inspection, execution, saved figure, and rerun verification.

docs.outline.workflows.build-library.tit.message: Build a core reading list for a new research topic

docs.outline.workflows.build-library.sco.message: When starting an unfamiliar topic, collect seed papers, map key themes and save a curated reading list linked to the project. Import and tagging are steps within this scenario.

docs.outline.workflows.import-library.ti.message: Take over and organize a paper collection

docs.outline.workflows.import-library.sc.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.outline.workflows.import-library.to.message: Take over a previous researcher's literature collection
Given PDFs and citation exports from a previous researcher, reconstruct a usable project library and produce a list of missing or ambiguous records.
Make a fragmented paper collection usable again
Given mixed folders, incomplete citations and missing attachments, reconcile records and full text into topic collections with an explicit unresolved-items list.

docs.outline.workflows.organize-library..message: Consolidate search batches for a review project
Combine records from several searches or databases into a deduplicated candidate set, retaining search provenance and a documented screening handoff.

docs.outline.workflows.review-inbox.titl.message: Prepare a focused reading pack for a journal club

docs.outline.workflows.review-inbox.scop.message: For an upcoming journal club, select papers around one question, review agent suggestions, collect available full text and prepare a reading order with discussion questions.

docs.outline.workflows.deduplicate-libra.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.
Reuse a literature base for a related research question
When a related project starts, identify relevant papers in the existing library, link them without duplicating records and document evidence gaps specific to the new question.
Refresh the evidence base before a project milestone

Before a proposal or progress review, run a fresh search, compare new findings with the saved collection and prepare a dated additions-and-gaps note. This is a manual workflow, not scheduled monitoring.

docs.outline.workflows.literature-review.message: Define a question, search and screen records, extract evidence, cite sources, and report access gaps.

docs.outline.workflows.paper-reading.sco.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.outline.workflows.paper-reading.top.message: Extract methods, populations, findings and limitations from provided papers; retain page-level evidence.
Check whether a paper supports a claim
Given a claim in a draft or meeting note, locate the relevant PDF passages and methods, retain page evidence and produce a supported, qualified or unsupported finding.

docs.outline.workflows.database-search.s.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.outline.workflows.database-search.t.message: Select a data source, formulate bounded queries, resolve identifiers, and save traceable records.
Resolve a mismatch between a paper and a database
When a paper and a database disagree about a gene, compound or trial, reconcile identifiers and versions and document what remains unresolved.

docs.outline.workflows.indication-dossie.message: Combine biology, epidemiology, trials and treatment evidence with source dates and unresolved gaps.

docs.outline.workflows.format-bibliograp.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.
Adapt a bibliography to a target journal

Use trusted Library item IDs and supported CSL styles. Cover formatted citations, DOCX with semantic citation markers, and an Overleaf-compatible LaTeX bundle; verify output fields and style requirements.
Audit a manuscript's references before submission
Given a manuscript and its source library, reconcile cited records, bibliographic fields, duplicates and accessible evidence, then produce a corrected bibliography and an exceptions list.

docs.outline.workflows.data-quality.titl.message: Check sample quality in a gene-count matrix

docs.outline.workflows.data-quality.scop.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.outline.workflows.data-quality.topi.message: Check types, missingness, duplicates and units; preserve raw inputs and record exclusions.
Prepare runtimes, inspect variables, execute incrementally, recover errors and save reusable scripts.

docs.outline.workflows.statistics.scope.message: State assumptions, select a method, check diagnostics, report uncertainty, and retain runnable code.

docs.outline.workflows.reproduce.scope.message: Inventory paper, code and data; define acceptance criteria, run a pilot and distinguish matches from deviations.

docs.outline.workflows.extend-analysis.t.message: Extend an analysis with an installed Specialist

docs.outline.workflows.extend-analysis.s.message: Existing Methods, QC PCA, matrix and evidence-planning examples.

docs.outline.workflows.sequence-qc.scope.message: Inspect FASTA records, alphabets and lengths; resolve annotation sources and preserve failed records.

docs.outline.workflows.single-cell.scope.message: Check expression inputs and metadata, choose scGPT or scvi-tools where appropriate, and validate outputs. Requires compatible single-cell input, a configured Python environment and the selected Skill dependencies; scientific execution remains pending.

docs.outline.workflows.structure-predict.message: Choose an available prediction Skill, check inputs and compute requirements, then inspect confidence and limitations. Requires the selected package, model weights and suitable local or remote compute; listing a Skill does not verify prediction execution.

docs.outline.workflows.molecular-analysi.message: Validate molecules, inspect properties and structures, and review docking poses without equating scores with affinity. Separate the local molecule viewer, online chemistry sources and DiffDock execution; docking requires its own dependencies and compute validation.

docs.outline.workflows.figures.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.outline.workflows.figures.topic.fig.message: Create panels from traceable data, check labels and visual fidelity, and export publication assets.

docs.outline.workflows.figures.topic.tra.message: Explain where a figure's result came from
When a collaborator questions a figure, trace the artifact to its execution and inputs, verify versions and prepare an evidence-backed explanation of the calculation.

docs.outline.workflows.manuscript.title.message: Write and revise a research report

docs.outline.workflows.manuscript.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.outline.workflows.manuscript.topic..message: Build a report or manuscript narrative
Connect verified findings, figure order, methods and citations; flag unsupported claims.
Revise a figure or report after reviewer feedback
Map feedback to saved outputs, make supported edits, compare revisions and prepare a response linking each change to the revised artifact.

docs.outline.workflows.recover-notebook..message: Rerun an analysis after the source data changes
Given an updated dataset, identify stale notebook outputs, rerun dependencies and compare new results with the previous deliverable to explain material changes.

docs.outline.workflows.ssh-analysis.scop.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.outline.workflows.ssh-analysis.topi.message: Run an analysis on an SSH host

Check host policy and readiness, stage inputs, monitor execution, and recover outputs into the project. Requires a user-provided reachable SSH host and tested credentials; no remote job has been verified in the current audit.

Confirm scheduler requirements, submit a bounded job, track its receipt, cancel or recover, and verify files. Requires an actual Slurm cluster, account and scheduler configuration; scheduler execution is not verified by local mode controls.

docs.outline.workflows.parallel-review.s.message: With a supported framework and working models, split a bounded task, configure Specialist capabilities, inspect delegated activity and approvals, and reconcile returned evidence. Verify delegation before claiming parallel execution.

docs.outline.workflows.plan-research.sco.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.outline.workflows.plan-research.top.message: Scope a pilot study before committing compute
Turn a broad question and limited resources into a small pilot plan with inputs, deliverables, stop conditions and acceptance checks before expanding the analysis.
Resume an unfinished study with a Session Plan

Resume user-initiated work from an approved Session Plan, recorded step status and saved results. Keep a remaining-work note; the plan does not imply unattended scheduling or a separate persistent-goal feature.
Resume a study after a break without losing decisions
Reconstruct a paused study from prior sessions, project memory and saved files, then produce a verified current-state note before further analysis.

docs.outline.workflows.compare-branches..message: Compare two analysis methods on the same dataset
Use the same documented inputs and preprocessing for two methods, execute both, and compare results, assumptions and limitations.

docs.outline.workflows.save-method.title.message: Reuse a validated analysis on a new dataset

docs.outline.workflows.save-method.scope.message: Convert a successful analysis into a reusable Skill, adapt declared inputs and verify the method on a new dataset without silently carrying over old assumptions.

docs.outline.workflows.handoff.title.message: Hand off a reproducible research package

docs.outline.workflows.handoff.scope.message: Review the included topics and their planned scope below.

docs.outline.workflows.handoff.topic.han.message: Collect inputs, scripts, environments, results and limitations; verify the package from a fresh state.

docs.outline.workflows.handoff.topic.exp.message: Hand an unfinished analysis to a collaborator
Prepare selected conversation evidence, result files, decisions, environment requirements and remaining questions as a reviewable handoff package.

docs.outline.tools.scope.message: Find tools by capability; catalogs and individual operations are planned as tables inside broad chapters.

docs.outline.tools.overview.scope.message: Choose between built-in tools, scientific software, database connectors and viewers; compare access and readiness in a table.

docs.outline.tools.built-in.scope.message: A table of file, notebook, literature, memory, planning and delegation operations with inputs, outputs and permissions.

docs.outline.tools.catalog.scope.message: A documentation table of software referenced by bundled Skills and inspected runtime packages, with purpose, dependencies and availability. Catalog entries are not all preinstalled software or a separate in-app catalog.

docs.outline.tools.scientific.scope.message: Explain execution through Notebook runtimes or configured Compute Hosts, with package installation, input/output checks and failure diagnosis. Record local versus remote requirements for each software example.

docs.outline.tools.databases.scope.message: A categorized table for the 23 data-source connectors: source coverage, exact operations, identifiers, credentials and limitations. The local Molecule Viewer is documented under Scientific viewers.

docs.outline.tools.tables.scope.message: Compare supported tabular formats, preview controls, data inspection, variable handling, exports and size limits in tables.

docs.outline.tools.viewers.scope.message: Use the actual preview registry for PDF, Office, images, FASTA, PDB and molecular formats. Include the offline OpenChemLib Molecule Viewer and its validation tools; distinguish viewing from editing or scientific computation.

docs.outline.tools.mcp.scope.message: Compare built-in and custom connectors, transports, discovery, enablement and errors; link configuration steps to Guides.

docs.outline.tools.credentials.scope.message: A service-to-credential table covering credential types, bindings, required scopes, validation and access failures.

docs.outline.tools.custom.scope.message: Connect an existing or externally implemented MCP server through local stdio or supported remote transport, inspect discovered tools and test credentials and permissions. Tool implementation is an external prerequisite.
